embeddedHelp.text:
GAME INFORMATION 
                
            
            
                "Wheel Of Destiny" is an instant win game, with BONUS GAME. 
            
            
            HOW TO PLAY
            
                Choose from the multiplier fields where to place your bets. 
            
            
                Press "PLAY" to spin the wheel and start the game. 
            
           
            
                 ALL
                DMO
            
            
                The wheel has 50 sectors with multipliers varying from 3x to 1200x. 
            
            
                If the wheel stops on a sector where you have placed bet on the multiplier field, you win. 
            
            
                If you bet on the "Up to 1200x" field and the wheel stops on its corresponding sector, a BONUS GAME is triggered. 
            
            
                If you bet on any of the other multipliers fields and the wheel stops on that multiplier sector, you win the amount bet on the multiplier multiplied by that multiplier. 
            
            
                Amounts bet on multiplier which are not selected after the wheel stops are lost. 
            
        

         
            
                
                    LIMITS 
                
            
            
                TheMinimum Betper game is:0.10 DMO 
                TheMaximum Betper game is:1000.00 DMO 
                TheMaximum Beton a bonus sector is:100.00 DMO 
                TheMaximum possiblewin is:120000.00 DMO
            
          


        
            
                
                    PRIZES 
                
            
            
               The win is calculated by multiplying the bet placed on the winning sector by the sector multiplier.The sectors in the wheel are distributed as follows:
            
            
                SECTOR TYPE
                NUMBER OF SECTORS
            
            
                SECTOR TYPE
                NUMBER OF SECTORS
            
        
        
        
            
                
                    BONUS GAME – “UP TO 1200x” 
                
            
            
            
                BONUS FEATURE 
            
            
                Entering the Bonus (up to 1200x):  When the player enters the Bonus, the wheel will contain enhanced multipliers ranging from 10x up to 150x, as well as an additional special symbol — “Double.”
            
            
            
            
                DOUBLE SYMBOL 
            
            
                Landing on the “Double” section doubles all current multipliers on the wheel. 
            
            
                The “Double” feature can be triggered a maximum of two times during the Bonus. 
            
            
                SPECIAL CASE 
            
            
                If the wheel lands on the “Double” symbol twice in a row during the Bonus, then on the third and final spin, all “Double” sections on the wheel will automatically transform into 1200x multipliers. 
            
         

        
            
                
                    BUTTONS 
                
            
            
                DMO
                ALL
                MY BETS
                TOP WINS
                Adjust bet size and nominal option
                Spin Button
                Clear Bet/Bet on all/Undo Bet
                Turbo Mode
                Statistics
                Menu Button
                Sound On / Off
            

        
        
            
                
                    AUTOPLAY 
                
            
            

            
            
                
                    The autoplay function will start each spin automatically. 
                
                
                    You can place up to 500 bets automatically, one after the other. 
                
                
                    Select your bet, then press "AUTOPLAY" to select the number of spins you want to play. 
                
                
                    Autoplay will pause if you enter a BONUS GAME, and will resume once the BONUS GAME is completed.•You can stop autoplay from continuing onto the next spin by pressing "STOP". 
                
            
         
        
            
                
                    OTHER RULES 
                
            
            RTP (return to player) percentage for this game is 96.00%. 
            
                DISCONNECT In case of the game disconnection after a bet is placed, if a winning bet was intended to come, a win will be deposited on the balance.
